findings.title: Volume mount hides the command
findings.cause: container api runs /bin/sleep, but volume scratch (an emptyDir, which starts empty) is mounted at /bin and replaces everything the image has there, so the command is not in the container; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "/bin/sleep": stat /bin/sleep: no such file or directory

evidence.what: container api mounts volume scratch at /bin, and its command is /bin/sleep

findings.fix: Mount volume scratch somewhere the image keeps no files (a subdirectory such as /bin/data), or use subPath to mount only the directory the app writes to.
